name: Sticky Web
doc: Sticky Web (Caterchipillar's attack): the root and the master - the silk thread and the web, the two particle flights, the burst at the target, the sound; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag153_sticky_web.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools and packet arenas in the module).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Master
parts.doc: The silk thread and the web, the two particle flights, the burst at the target, the sound; the damage

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The damage at this tick of the master

params.label: Particle
params.doc: The sprite sequence particle (a flipbook of 16 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Web model
params.doc: The prim model web (a mesh of 314 vertices, 336 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Burst model
params.doc: The prim model burst (a mesh of 60 vertices, 48 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))
